author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
One of the great joys of studio-scale modelmaking is replicating a model using the same techniques and donor kit parts that the original designers used in their iconic spaceships. At this year's Wonderfestm, modelmaker Scott Thibaudeau introduces us to his studio scale B-Wing, a scratch built recreation of the original Bill George design, down to the last decal. We geek out over this model and discuss why it's so beloved among Star Wars fans. 

Watch more videos from WonderFest here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJtitKU0CAeisqS5CxeSZ5MRXtlTULAqo
Learn more about WonderFest at https://www.wonderfest.com/
Read Scott's build log for this B-Wing: https://www.therpf.com/forums/threads/studio-scale-b-wing-starfighter-build-thread.361068/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
